'''Medical frigate 517''' was the designation of a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used to transport [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] from [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
